title: IIT Roorkee: overview, contacts and student portals
content:
# IIT Roorkee: overview, contacts and student portals

Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee, IITR) is in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, and describes itself as one of India's oldest institutions of higher learning. Website: https://www.iitr.ac.in

## Contacts
- Phone: +91-1332-285311
- Registrar: registrar@iitr.ac.in
- Website feedback: img@iitr.ac.in
- Contact page: https://iitr.ac.in/Institute/Contact%20Us.html
- Directions: https://iitr.ac.in/Institute/How%20To%20Reach%20IIT%20Roorkee.html
- Telephone directory: https://iitr.ac.in/support/td/

## Student portals
- Academic login: https://academics.iitr.ac.in
- Intranet (Channel i): https://channeli.in/
- Webmail: https://newwebmail.iitr.ac.in/
- iConnect: https://iconnect.iitr.ac.in/
- Library (MGCL): https://mgcl.iitr.ac.in/
- Placements (PIC): https://pic.iitr.ac.in/
- Hostels (bhawans): https://iitr.ac.in/Campus%20Life/Hostels.html
- Online fee deposit: https://iitr.ac.in/Resources/Funds%20Transfer/Online%20Fee%20Deposit.html
- Guest house booking: http://ghbooking.iitr.ac.in/
- Healthcare and IITR Hospital: https://iitr.ac.in/Resources/Healthcare/index.html (hospital: http://hosp.iitr.ac.in/)
- Support @ IITR: https://www.iitr.ac.in/support/
- Internal Complaints Committee: https://www.iitr.ac.in/internalcomplaintscommittee/
- Safety: https://www.iitr.ac.in/safety/index.html

title: IIT Roorkee admissions and fee documents (2026-27)
content:
# IIT Roorkee admissions and fee documents (2026-27)

Admissions hub: https://iitr.ac.in/Academics/Admission.html (UG, PG and PhD). Dates and venues are in the documents linked from each page.

## Undergraduate (Autumn 2026-27)
https://iitr.ac.in/Academics/Admission%20To%20Undergraduate%20Programmes.html lists: document verification and registration schedule and venue for UG Admission 2026, a sample offer letter for UG admission **through JEE (Advanced) 2026**, the orientation programme for parents of new UG entrants 2026, and B.Des admission 2026 information. B.Tech/B.Arch seats at IITs are allotted through JoSAA after JEE (Advanced).

## Postgraduate (tentative schedule for PG admissions 2026)
https://iitr.ac.in/Academics/Admission%20To%20Postgraduate%20Programmes.html has sections for M.Des (Industrial Design), M.Tech/M.Arch/M.U.R.P., M.Tech (VLSI) for industry professionals, M.Sc, MBA, international students and Executive MBA. Open each section for its entrance route and eligibility.

## PhD
https://iitr.ac.in/Academics/Admission%20To%20Doctoral%20Programmes.html

## Fee structure 2026-27
https://iitr.ac.in/Academics/Institute%20Fees.html links separate fee documents for UG new entrants (B.Tech/B.Arch/BS-MS/Int. M.Tech/B.Des), existing UG students, PhD, M.Tech/M.Arch/M.U.R.P/M.Des, MBA, M.Sc and preparatory courses. Amounts are only in those documents.

title: IIT Roorkee academic calendar and student support
content:
# IIT Roorkee academic calendar and student support

## Academic calendar
https://iitr.ac.in/Academics/Academic%20Calendar.html lists the **Academic Calendars for Autumn Semester 2026-27**, separately for 'All Programs (Other than MBA)' and the 'MBA Programme', plus archives for Spring 2025-26, Spring 2024-25 and Autumn 2025-26/2024-25. A notice 'Updated teaching days for UG I Year' is also posted. Semester, exam and vacation dates are inside the linked calendars.

## Health and support
- IITR Hospital: http://hosp.iitr.ac.in/ (via https://iitr.ac.in/Resources/Healthcare/index.html)
- Support @ IITR: https://www.iitr.ac.in/support/
- Internal Complaints Committee: https://www.iitr.ac.in/internalcomplaintscommittee/
- Institute phone: +91-1332-285311

The healthcare page doesn't list a counselling or wellness contact; ask through Support @ IITR or the hospital.
